backend_readme.contract: Old string-model backend READMEs are replaced by typed representation and solver API references; no executable algorithm is stored here.

build_configuration.contract: Legacy Sage/webapp/CI/build configuration is replaced by the v5 Python package and pinned release/solver workflows. Vendor deployment configuration is not part of scientific numerical parity.

byte_preserved.contract: Original bytes are retained. Presence alone is not evidence that a resource is exercised. Native NIST resources have a separate numerical/resource guard.

documentation.contract: Legacy documentation is reference material, not a runtime dependency. The user-reviewed v5 guide is intentionally unchanged; external tutorial conversion is excluded.

external_template_link.contract: The old absolute /opt/sts-2.1.2-modified/templates symlinks are not portable. The native NIST templates are retained byte-for-byte; external STS owns its installed templates.

generated_c_helpers.contract: Typed C generation replaces the four legacy C helper sources. Compiled outputs are checked against scalar execution.

reference_artifact.contract: The generated TEA LP dump is not an implementation. The Sage precomputed-results archive is retained verbatim as provenance; portable fixtures and real solver tests own executable evidence.

report_template.contract: Typed result-owned table export replaces the legacy CSV diffusion template.
